abstract: Let $-D < 0$ be a fundamental discriminant with class number $h = h(-D)$ and class-group exponent $e = \exp(\mathrm{Cl}(-D))$ in $K = \mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-D})$. Using Hasse-Schmidt divided jets on a Euclidean disk $E_{\rho_n} \subset \mathcal{O}_K$ over $\Lambda_{\text{tri}} = \{(r,s) : r + Ks < KS = R\}$, Theorem 1.1 proves under $h(-D) = 1$ ($D \notin S$) that $D \leq B_{\text{RS}} = 4,894,699$ ($B_{\text{prime}} = 3,968,539$, $B_{\text{hybrid}} = 875$) inside the inert window $X = \frac{D-3}{4}$. We establish three extensions beyond $X$: (1) Fubini-Jensen $C^1$ level-set convex duality, Unified Stieltjes Integration on $[K, R]$, the Multi-Branch Norm-Form Window on $(X, 29X]$, and $k \in \{2, 3, 4\}$ UFD cluster subtraction lower the $h(-D) = 1$ analytical tail to $D_{\text{tail}}^{\text{MB}} = 34,000$, the Rosser-Schoenfeld ladder to $B_{\text{RS}}^{\text{MB}} = 22,123$, the exact-prime ladder to $B_{\text{prime}}^{\text{MB}} = 17,843$, the Fubini-Jensen hybrid threshold to $B_{\text{hybrid}}^{\text{FJ}} = 691$ ($D \leq 651$ fundamental, $D \leq 643$ under $h(-D) = 1$), and—combining Wronskian rank [25, 26] at $K = 43, \varepsilon_J = 0.125, \theta \approx 0.7978$ with the Meixner/composition/Schur bound [22]—certify width-4 intervals to $B_{\text{hybrid}}^{\text{MS}} = 551$ and discrete $D_0 \in \{547, 523, 515, 491\}$ to $D \leq 499$ and $D \neq 491$ ($\log 499 \approx 6.2126$) under $h(-D) = 1$ and across fundamental $D_0 \equiv 3 \pmod{8}$ (Theorem 1.2); (2) the 2D Minkowski-Gauss Window and 2-torsion fiber injection bounds classify all $3,793$ fields with $1 \leq h(-D) \leq 30$ across all $47$ abelian groups of order $\leq 30$ without $L$-functions (Theorem 1.3); and (3) genus-rank stratification with the Master Multi-Shell Delannoy Capacity Identity proves $D < 33,000 \cdot h^{\alpha^*(e)}(\log(h+2))^2$ analytically ($D < 18,000 \cdot h^{\alpha^*(e)}(\log(h+2))^2$ with Theorem 1.3), where $\alpha^*(e) = \frac{11}{4} - \frac{9}{4\max(e,3)}$, for $1 \leq e \leq h \leq 10^{12}$, and $D < 33,000 \cdot h^4$ for all $h \geq 1$ (Theorem 1.4).

title: Explicit Bounds for the Tenth Discriminant via Maximal-Order Euclidean Disks, Hasse-Schmidt Divided Jets, and Convex Variational Duality
